Ethan now understands the reasons behind Gary’s overworking, so he no longer merely suspects that Gary is hiding something. Instead, he believes Gary’s behavior has understandable reasons.
- In Scenario 4, after months of checking in, Ethan sees that Gary is making efforts to change and is reporting improvement, such as having time for a movie. Ethan’s belief is now that Gary is making progress toward a healthier balance.
- Ethan does not yet believe in Scenario 4 that Gary can fully manage on his own; that belief becomes relevant in Scenario 5 after another year.

So the belief changes from “Gary’s reasons are justified” to “Gary is making progress.”
